description: Template for config\local\expected.json, the machine profile: known-good items of ONE PC. The scanner reads only the 'items' list, which is empty here on purpose, so copying this file changes nothing. Every item you add takes something out of the verdict, so add one only after the user confirmed that exact item. Move an entry from 'examples' into 'items' and adapt it. A match caps the finding at 'severityCap' (default info) and marks it explained, unless one of its 'invalidIf' conditions holds. 'confirmWithUser': true keeps the question open in the report. Format and categories: docs\schema.md. How to fill it in: docs\agent\calibrate.md. Some ids are recognised by name and switch on extra logic in a collector: this-project (extra paths of this scanner), security-tooling-repos, tailscale, asus-glidex, ollama-loopback, defender-off-avast, pentest-tools, codex-sandbox-firewall, startup-known. Keep those ids when you adapt the matching examples.
